description: This file manages web search provider configurations, including cloning configs, setting providers, handling credentials, merging configs, and resolving plugin settings within the openclaw project.

methods.name: cloneWithDescriptors
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object with property descriptors.

methods.name: withForcedProvider
methods.description: Returns a new config object with the specified search provider enforced.

methods.name: getTopLevelCredentialValue
methods.description: Retrieves the top-level API key from a search configuration object.

methods.name: setTopLevelCredentialValue
methods.description: Sets the top-level API key in a search configuration object.

methods.name: getScopedCredentialValue
methods.description: Retrieves a scoped API key from a search configuration object by key.

methods.name: setScopedCredentialValue
methods.description: Sets a scoped API key in a search configuration object for a given key.

methods.name: mergeScopedSearchConfig
methods.description: Merges plugin configuration into an existing scoped search configuration, optionally mirroring the API key to top-level.

methods.name: resolveSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves and returns the web search configuration from the main config.

methods.name: resolveProviderWebSearchPluginConfig
methods.description: Resolves plugin-specific web search configuration using plugin ID.

methods.name: setProviderWebSearchPluginConfigValue
methods.description: Sets a specific key-value pair in a plugin's web search configuration.

methods.name: resolveSearchEnabled
methods.description: Determines if search is enabled based on configuration and sandbox status.
